content: {"reasoning":"The claim was denied CO-197 (prior auth missing at time of service). Prior auth is REQUIRED but missing, this payer offers no retroactive authorization and no peer-to-peer, and an appeal has already been filed. CO-197 is a provider-liability adjustment, so the balance cannot be billed to the patient, and resubmitting a paid/adjudicated claim would trigger CO-18. No available action can recover the allowed amount, so the balance is uncollectible.","action":"write_off"}
